Spacecraft Tyvak-0171 (SIRION-2?, EchoStar 2, Helios 3)
Form factor CubeSat
Units or mass 6U
Status Reentry 2024-02-10. Was semi-operational? (Propulsion failed and did not reach nominal operational altitude, but otherwise likely operational)
Launched 2020-09-03
NORAD ID 46295
Deployer RailPOD [Tyvak]
Launcher Vega (Small Satellite Mission Service)
Organization EchoStar
Institution Company
Entity Commercial
Nation US
Manufacturer AIVT by Terran Orbital
Oneliner

Two tiny S-band satellites to jumpstart a low-Earth-orbit constellation using spectrum gained through its acquisition of Helios Wire. 
Failure cause Propulsion from a supplier failed.
Notes

Not officially acknowledged, but very likely EchoStar CubeSat.
